text: Find hardwood lumber suppliers serving manufacturers; exclude suppliers documented as serving builders, contractors or DIY buyers.
Distributors or producers of decorative hardwood lumber, plywood or architectural millwork for fabricators and design professionals.
Companies whose documented business supplies structural wood building materials or components to professional construction buyers.
Find distributors of metal sheets or coils and supplies used in HVAC duct fabrication.
Companies supplying heat-transfer coils, fan coils or replacement coil equipment for HVAC; distinguish these from electronic magnetic coils.
Companies whose documented primary offering is equipment for commercial or industrial refrigeration and cooling.
Companies supplying air filtration or ventilation equipment for commercial, industrial or institutional buildings.
Third-party technical organizations offering ISO or management-system certification and audit services.
Companies whose primary described business tests, inspects or certifies materials and manufactured products.
Testing and certification organizations with documented food safety work or a broader compliance testing service relevant to food producers.
Find clinical pediatric dentistry providers delivering preventive or restorative dental care to children.
Pediatric dental care providers; exclude organizations documented to offer general family dentistry or orthodontic treatment for adults.
Organizations whose documented business supports dentists and multi-location dental practices with administrative and growth services.
Software vendors serving dental practices with scheduling, billing, imaging or multi-location practice management.
Purchasing organizations or procurement groups serving hospitals, health systems or other healthcare sites.
Buying groups and procurement providers helping restaurants manage food purchasing, rebates or supplier economics.
Cooperative purchasing and procurement organizations serving local government, schools or other public institutions.
Service businesses that perform industrial maintenance, inspection or repair on customers' operating assets.
Companies delivering commercial building mechanical services, facilities operations or HVAC equipment maintenance.
Custom production providers offering CNC machining or related precision part manufacturing across industrial end markets.
Providers offering aluminum, zinc or magnesium die casting and related precision machining or finishing.
Companies providing physical cold storage and refrigerated or frozen supply-chain logistics.
Physical logistics providers offering ecommerce fulfillment, parcel delivery or direct-to-consumer distribution.
Companies providing freight brokerage, freight forwarding or transportation management services for shippers.
Recruiting and staffing service companies supplying nurses, allied-health professionals or physicians to healthcare employers.
Service providers recruiting industrial workers or maintenance technicians for manufacturing, construction and logistics employers.
Business software for residential or commercial trade contractors covering jobs, quotes, dispatch, invoicing or payments.
Software vendors supporting construction project teams and builders with scheduling, project workflows, financials or client communication.
Software providers for property managers covering leasing, rent, accounting, maintenance or resident operations.
Legal technology providers supporting law practices with matters, documents, billing, clients or legal research.
Software platforms for staffing agencies with recruiting, applicant tracking, client relationships, payroll or billing.
Software providers for restaurant operations with point of sale, ordering, inventory, accounting or workforce tools.
Vendors providing payroll and HR software for employers, including employee data, scheduling, benefits or onboarding.
Technology vendors providing fleet visibility, shipping management, customs compliance or logistics workflow software.
Fraud and financial-crime technology for banks or financial institutions, including transaction monitoring, AML or investigations.
Technology protecting ecommerce merchants or digital commerce from fraudulent purchases, chargebacks, account abuse or returns abuse.
Find bank fraud platforms; exclude any company explicitly documented as also serving merchants, merchant acquirers or payment service providers.
Companies whose documented business includes physical commercial printing, direct mail, signs or branded printed materials.
